text: And since a wilful and evil intention, partly executed, such as this perpetrated against her mistress by the prisoner, is not to be tolerated in a country where law and justice are practised, but should be punished in an exemplary fashion to deter other similarly inclined malefactors.
html: And since a wilful and evil intention, partly executed, such as this perpetrated against her mistress by the prisoner, is not to be tolerated in a country where law and justice are practised, but should be punished in an exemplary fashion to deter other similarly inclined malefactors.

text: Thus it is, that the honourable Council of Justice of this government, serving today, having seen and considered the written crimineelen eijsch ende conclusie of the honourable Independent Fiscal, Pieter Reede van Oudshoorn, drawn up and delivered in his official capacity for and against the prisoner, as well as having noted the prisoner’s own voluntary confession, properly verified, and everything else which served the case and could have moved their honours, practising justice in the name and on behalf of the high and mighty Lords States General of the United Netherlands, as well as his most serene highness, the Lord Prince of Orange and Nassau, as hereditary Stadholder, Captain and Admiral General of the Republic, having judged the prisoner Raachel van de Caab, their honours are sentencing her with this: to be taken to the place where criminal sentences are usually executed here and, after being handed over to the executioner, first to be exposed on the gallows with a rope around her neck, then to be tied to a stake and to be severely flogged with whips, and thereafter to be branded, further to be put into chains for all her life, to be sold publicly like this for the profit of her owner, the burgher Jacobus van Reenen junior, on the condition that she may never again come into the possession of him or his; with sentencing to the costs and expenditures of justice.

text: Thus done and sentenced in the Castle of Good Hope on 31 January 1754, as also pronounced and executed on the 2nd of the month thereupon, February.

text: Let the sentence be done!
[signed] R. Tulbagh.

heading: 1755 — Crime Records (Slaves: Januarij van Boegies)
text: 1755 — Crime Records (Slaves: Januarij van Boegies)
html: 1755 — Crime Records (Slaves: Januarij van Boegies)

text: Aangesien uijt de vrijwillige gerecolleerde confessie van Januarij van Boegies, lijfeijgen der erfgenaamen van wijlen de weedw. van den overleedenen Capitain Lieutenant Militair Godfried Gerhard Schindelaar, oud naar gissing 45 jaaren, thans ’s heeren gevangen, en andere stucken ten processe gevoegt, het den E. Atgbe. Raad van Justitie deeses Gouvernements is komen te blijken:
html: Aangesien uijt de vrijwillige gerecolleerde confessie van Januarij van Boegies, lijfeijgen der erfgenaamen van wijlen de weedw. van den overleedenen Capitain Lieutenant Militair Godfried Gerhard Schindelaar, oud naar gissing 45 jaaren, thans ’s heeren gevangen, en andere stucken ten processe gevoegt, het den E. Atgbe. Raad van Justitie deeses Gouvernements is komen te blijken:

text: Dat hij gevangen op Sondag sijnde geweest den 2 der eeven afgeweekenen maand November, des agtermiddags te huijs gekomen sijnde, desselfs meede slavin Clara van Maccassar bij de welke hij gevangen het is houdende geweest, en waarbij hij verschijde kinderen verweckt heeft, neevens sijn meede slaaf Augustus genaamt, te samen alleen, in de Galderij heeft gevonden, ende hij Augustus op het gesigt van hem gevangen, sig in de agterkamer bij een aldaar staande wieg, waarin des gevangens jongste kind lag, begeevende om het selve te wiegen, vroeg den gevangen door minnenijd aangedreeven, aan voorm. Clara wat of dien jonge, op wien hij al langen tijd eenige jaloesie had opgevat, bij haar te doen had, ende deselve daarop geantwoord hebbende niemendal, dat hij haar kind dewijl hetselve huijlde was wiegende, en dat niet wist, dat daar jets quaads in stack, is den gevangen hierop toornig geworden, en onder ’t seggen, teegens voorm. Clara: Jij hebt een ziel en ik heb een ziel, naar de agterplaats gegaan, ende alsdoen volgens sijn voorgeeven, door quaathijd buijten sig selfs rakende, heeft hij gev. een parrang of kapmes (hem in judicio vertoont) in plaats van een stuck brandhout dat willens was te haalen om voorsijde Clara daarmeede te slaan, in hand bekomen, waarmeede hij gev. sig, naar eerst de voordeur toegeslooten, en de sleutel daarvan in sijn sack gestooken te hebben, naar de agterkamer waarin voorm. Clara en Augustus neevens het klinjste kind van wijlen sijn lijfvrouw, en ’twelke voorm. Clara was aankleedende uijt vreese voor hem gev. gevlugt waaren, begeeven, als wanneer hij gev. haar Clara, die neevens eevengem. Augustus reets uijt het vengster buijtens huijs was gesprongen, en beesig was, om het voorm. kind insgelijx bij haar op de stoep te willen tillen, agtervolgt, en deselve alsdoen met de voorm. parrang eerst een kap aan de regter sijde van het voorhoofd, tot de eerste tafel van het beckeneel penetreerende, en voorts nog twee kappen in de regter hand, de eene ruijm vijf, en de andere seeven vingeren lang, toegebragt heeft, waarna hij gev. sig met voorm. parrang op de vlugt, en naar het Tafelgebergte heeft begeeven, van waar de tweede nagt over de agterste platjes van wijlen sijn lijfvrouws wooning op de binnenplaats gekomen is, om sijn waakrock soo als voorgeeft te hebben willen haalen, dog denselven niet kunnende magtig werden, is hij gev. weederom naar ’t gebergte gemarcheert, alwaar sig tot den 10 der voorm. maand November heeft opgehouden, als wanneer door honger geperst des avonds in de thuijn van de weedw. van wijlen den oud Burgerraad Sr. Jan de Wit is gekomen en sig aan den aldaar beschijdenen knegt gevangen overgegeeen hebbende, vervolgens in handen van de Justitie is geraakt.

text: Ende nademaal sulk een gepleegde moordadige quetsing in een welgestelde Regeering daar regt ende geregtighijd word gehandhaaft, niet te dulden is, maar met alle rigeur teegengegaan en geweert moet werden.
html: Ende nademaal sulk een gepleegde moordadige quetsing in een welgestelde Regeering daar regt ende geregtighijd word gehandhaaft, niet te dulden is, maar met alle rigeur teegengegaan en geweert moet werden.

text: So is ’t dat den E. Agtbaaren Raad van Justitie voorm., ten dage dienende, aandagtelijk geleesen en geresumeert hebbende, den schriftelijken Crimineelen Eijsch ende Conclusie, door den Heer Independent Fiscaal Pieter Reede van Oudshoorn ex officio op ende jeegens den gev. gedaan en genoomen, en daarneevens geleth op des gevangens vrijwillige gerecolleerde confessie, voorts op alle hetgeene ter saake dienende was, en haar E. E. Agtb. eenigsints konden doen moveeren regt doende uijt naame ende van weegens de Hoogmoogende Heeren Staaten Generaal der Vereenigde Nederlanden, mitsgaders van sijne doorlugtigste Hoogheid den Heere Prince van Oranjen en Nassouw, als Erfstadhouder, Capitain en Admiraal Generaal van de Republicq, den gev. Januarij van Boegies, hebben gecondemneeren, mits deesen, om gebragt te werden, ter plaatse alwaar men alhier gewoon is, Crimineele Sententien te executeeren, en aldaar aan den Scherpregter overgeleevert sijnde, soodanig met de koorde aan de galg te worden gestraft, dat er de dood naar volgt, voorts desselfs doode ligham naar ’t buijten geregt, gesleept, en aldaar weeder opgehangen sijnde dus te verblijven tot dat door de lugt en de vogelen der heemels, sal sijn verteert, met condemnatie in de kosten en misen van Justitie, en ontsegging van den anders gedaanen Eijsch van den Heer Fiscaal.

text: Aldus gedaan en gesententieert in ’t Casteel de Goede Hoop, den 4 December 1755, mitsgaders gepronuncieert, ende g’executeert, den 6 daaraanvolgende.
html: Aldus gedaan en gesententieert in ’t Casteel de Goede Hoop, den 4 December 1755, mitsgaders gepronuncieert, ende g’executeert, den 6 daaraanvolgende.

text: Fiat Executie, [get.] R. Tulbagh.
TRANSLATION

Since, from the voluntary and verified confession of Januarij van Boegies, bondsman of the heirs of the late widow of the passed away Captain Lieutenant of the military, Godfried Gerhard Schindelaar, 45 years old at a guess, currently their honours’ prisoner, and from the other papers produced in the case, it has come to appear to the honourable Council of Justice of this government:
html: Since, from the voluntary and verified confession of Januarij van Boegies, bondsman of the heirs of the late widow of the passed away Captain Lieutenant of the military, Godfried Gerhard Schindelaar, 45 years old at a guess, currently their honours’ prisoner, and from the other papers produced in the case, it has come to appear to the honourable Council of Justice of this government:

text: That on Sunday, the 2nd of the just passed month November, coming home during the afternoon, the prisoner found together alone in the galderij, his fellow slave Clara van Macassar – with whom the prisoner was having a relationship and by whom he had produced several children – and his fellow slave called Augustus. And when Augustus saw the prisoner, he went into the back room to a cradle standing there, in which the prisoner’s youngest child was lying, in order to rock it. The prisoner, driven by the jealousy of love, asked the aforementioned Clara what this jongen, against whom he had for a long time conceived some jealousy, had to do with her, and to which she answered: “Nothing at all”, that he was rocking her child while it was crying, and that she did not see anything wrong with that. Upon this, the prisoner became angry and, while saying to the aforementioned Clara: “You have a soul, and I have a soul”, went to the backyard where he picked up a parrang or machette (shown to him in court), instead of the piece of firewood which he had wanted to get to beat the aforesaid Clara, and with which he, after first having locked the front door and putting its key in his pocket, went to the back room from which the aforementioned Clara and Augustus, as also the youngest child of his late owner whom Clara was busy clothing, had fled out of fear for him. Which is when the prisoner pursued Clara – who, together with the aforementioned Augustus, had already climbed through the window to the outside of the house and was busy lifting the aforementioned child to them onto the stoep – and inflicted on her, with the aforementioned parrang, a cut on the right side of her forehead which penetrated to the first table of the cranium, and two more cuts on her right hand, the one fully five and the other seven fingers long, after which he proceeded to flee with the aforementioned parrang to Table Mountain; from where, on the second night, he came over the back flat-roofed house of his late owner’s residence onto the inside yard, wanting, so he asserts, to pick up his oilskin coat. However, since he could not get possession of the same, he once again returned to the mountain, where he stayed until the 10th of the aforementioned month November when, forced by hunger, he came into the garden of the widow of the late ex-burgher councillor Sieur Jan de Wit and handed himself over as prisoner to the knecht assigned there; and so coming into the hands of justice.

However, since he could not get possession of the same, he once again returned to the mountain, where he stayed until the 10th of the aforementioned month November when, forced by hunger, he came into the garden of the widow of the late ex-burgher councillor Sieur Jan de Wit and handed himself over as prisoner to the knecht assigned there; and so coming into the hands of justice.

text: And since the perpetration of such a murderous wounding is not to be tolerated in a well-appointed government where law and justice are practised, but should be opposed and prevented with all rigour.
html: And since the perpetration of such a murderous wounding is not to be tolerated in a well-appointed government where law and justice are practised, but should be opposed and prevented with all rigour.

text: Thus it is, that the aforementioned honourable Council of Justice, serving today, having seen and read attentively the written crimineelen eijsch ende conclusie, delivered and drawn up for and against  the prisoner by the honourable Independent Fiscal, Pieter Reede van Oudshoorn, in his official capacity, and apart from that, having noted the prisoner’s voluntary and verified confession, and moreover everything which served the case in any way and could have moved their honours, practising justice in the name and on behalf of the high and mighty Lords States General of the United Netherlands, as also of his most serene Highness, the Lord Prince of Orange and Nassau, as hereditary Stadholder, Captain and Admiral General of the Republic, is sentencing the prisoner, Januarij van Bougies, with this: to be taken to the place where criminal sentences are usually executed here and there to be handed over to the executioner, to be punished with the ropes on the gallows in such a way that death will follow, further his dead body to be dragged to the outer place of execution, and there to be hanged up once again, to remain thus until having been consumed by the air and the birds of heaven; with sentencing to the costs and expenditures of justice, and denying the otherwise drawn-up eijsch of the honourable Fiscal.

text: Thus done and sentenced in the Castle of Good Hope on 4 December 1755, as also pronounced and executed on the 6th thereupon.
